visualCharacteristics: Light band with a breadcrumb trail (Home > current page) above a large page heading.
contentPattern: Rows: breadcrumb links (Home, current page), then the page H1.
usage: Top of interior and listing pages (agency directory, news) to show the page title and breadcrumb.
reuseGuidance: Use for any interior page that opens with breadcrumb + title and no image; use hero-home for the homepage.
